name: The Roman Empire under Trajan, with temple estates
blurb: Peak territorial extent, sound currency, superb civil engineering, an economy resting on slavery, and an elite that despises manual work. This variant adds the temple estates that held land and lent at interest. Needs `mod-allow bh_religion_h5p1` for the house to exist.

cast.actors.name: the temple estates
cast.actors.source: Temples as landowners and lenders in the Roman east: Dignas, Economy of the Sacred in Hellenistic and Roman Asia Minor (2002), on the estates of Artemis at Ephesus and the loans of sanctuaries. No temple mill is attested to a degree that fixes a share, so milling is left at none. The sizes are placeholders of the right order, not counts.
cast.actors._heuristic: land_share_of_surplus is the share of a year's surplus the house spends on land and land_ceiling_hectares the most it will hold (three times its start, a guess); a stand-in until donors, the house's own rule and the land market's offers are modelled actors (Complaints/636).
